title: Air Fryer Exchange Guide
excerpt: If an air fryer does not fit the kitchen or meet the customer's needs, bring the clean, undamaged appliance, receipt, and all original accessories to the service desk within 30 days to exchange it for another model, subject to a condition check.

title: Small Appliance Exchange Price Guide
excerpt: For an approved exchange, the customer pays the difference for a higher-priced replacement or receives the difference for a lower-priced replacement.

title: Opened Appliance Condition Guide
excerpt: The condition check confirms that an opened appliance is clean, undamaged, and includes all original accessories before an exchange is approved.
